name: Egypt
shortSummary: India and Egypt, historic Non-Aligned Movement partners since the Nehru-Nasser era, elevated ties to a Strategic Partnership in 2023 when President Sisi served as India's Republic Day chief guest.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Egypt's Suez Canal is critical to India's trade with Europe and the Mediterranean.
Long-standing political trust rooted in shared Non-Aligned Movement leadership.

recentDevelopments.title: Strategic Partnership implementation continues
recentDevelopments.description: Following the 2023 elevation to a Strategic Partnership during President Sisi's Republic Day visit, both sides continued expanding trade and defence engagement.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Consolidates a historic Non-Aligned Movement relationship into a more concrete modern partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Non-Aligned Movement Solidarity
historicalEvents.description: PM Nehru and President Nasser jointly help found the Non-Aligned Movement, anchoring decades of India-Egypt political solidarity.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership Established
historicalEvents.description: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi attends India's Republic Day as chief guest, and both nations elevate ties to a Strategic Partnership.

agreements.name: India-Egypt Strategic Partnership
agreements.description: Framework agreement covering trade, defence, and cultural cooperation.

defenceCooperation.name: Exercise Cyclone
defenceCooperation.description: Bilateral special forces exercise between India and Egypt.

trade.majorSectors: Petroleum, fertilisers, Suez Canal trade transit
